answer.report_md:
## 画出来要什么
一个双面板（A/B）横排的排序条形图：27 个国家代码沿 x 轴斜排，条形按值升序排列，零线横贯，正负双向；两个面板量程不同（A：6…-6，B：1…-8），刻度单位 "p.p." 写在最高刻度上方；每个面板自带标题 "A. Green-driven occupations"；OECD 那根条单独涂红，无图例说明；绘图区带浅灰底与纵向分隔带；图上不印任何数值。标题需拆成 "Annex Figure 2.C.12."＋标题句＋单独一行的 "Percentage points, 2021 for EU-OECD countries and 2015 for the United States"。页面顶部还悬着上一张图（2.C.11）的 Note/Reading/Source 与一条 StatLink，全页共两个 StatLink。

## 定位一个值难在哪
以 -3.2 为例：它是面板 B 那根红色 OECD 条，但 B 面板里 LVA 也约 -3.2，两者仅差半个像素；刻度间隔 1 p.p.，而 5% 容差只有 0.16 p.p.，只能靠像素估读。要唯一定位还需三段标签：图号、"B. GHG-intensive occupations"、"OECD"，而 "OECD" 的红色含义只在 Note 里以 "Unweighted average" 暗示。

## 不确定的
条形具体数值全靠估读，只有 Greece 5.5 与 Italy 4.4 在 Reading 行里以文字给出；x 轴标签倾斜密集，个别代码（EST/ESP、SVN/SWE）辨认存疑；面板底纹究竟是灰底还是纵向网格线无法确定。

heading.title: Gap in the share of green-driven or GHG-intensive occupations in non-strained jobs compared with strained jobs
heading.unit_text: Percentage points, 2021 for EU-OECD countries and 2015 for the United States

axes.serves: all bars in Panel A only
country codes under Panel A bars
all bars in Panel B only
country codes under Panel B bars

worked_example.why_hard: No printed value; ticks every 1 p.p.; a neighbouring country bar has nearly identical length.

components.evidence: bars hang below a drawn zero line; Panel A axis reads 6 down to -6
a solid horizontal rule at 0 spans the full width of both panels
one bar in each panel, at tick 'OECD', is drawn red among green bars
country codes are set at roughly 45 degrees under both panels
'p.p.' is printed above the top tick '6' (Panel A) and '1' (Panel B)
heading line 'Percentage points, 2021 for EU-OECD countries and 2015 for the United States'
'A. Green-driven occupations' and 'B. GHG-intensive occupations' sit above each panel
two side-by-side panels A and B of the same bar-chart form
Panel A ticks 6 to -6 step 2; Panel B ticks 1 to -8 step 1
'Note: The chart reports the difference...', 'Reading: In Panel A, in Greece...', 'Source: Secretariat's estimates...'
'StatLink' glyph with 'https://stat.link/32xqhj' under the note block
plot area of both panels is filled light grey behind the bars, page is white
the top note block belongs to a figure not drawn on this page

new_components.name: orphan_note_block_from_previous_figure
new_components.evidence: page opens with Note/Reading/Source and 'https://stat.link/dmu0tr' for a figure printed on an earlier page

new_components.name: value_stated_in_reading_note
new_components.evidence: 'in Greece, the share ... is 5.5 percentage points lower'; 'In Italy ... 4.4 percentage points higher'

new_components.name: bars_sorted_by_value
new_components.evidence: bars in each panel run monotonically from most negative (GRC, LTU) to most positive (ITA, SVN)

new_components.name: two_statlink_blocks_one_page
new_components.evidence: 'https://stat.link/dmu0tr' near the top and 'https://stat.link/32xqhj' at the bottom

the rightmost bar of Panel A, at tick 'ITA'

answer.hardest_step_why: 图上无数字；B面板刻度间隔1 p.p.，-3.2的5%容差仅0.16，OECD与LVA两根条几乎等长，估读必超差。

examples.quote: one bar in each panel, at the tick 'OECD', is drawn red while all other bars are green; no legend
examples.why: 红色标示的是无加权平均这一属性，图例未给，需把该属性写进键。

examples.quote: 'A. Green-driven occupations' with axis 6 to -6; 'B. GHG-intensive occupations' with axis 1 to -8
examples.why: 同一国家代码在两面板各有一值，面板名与各自量程必须进入键。

examples.quote: 'Annex Figure 2.C.12. Gap in the share...' then a separate line 'Percentage points, 2021 for EU-OECD countries and 2015 for the United States'
examples.why: 图号带Annex编号，单位与年份另起一行，标题需拆成四个字段。

examples.quote: bars run both above and below a solid zero rule; 'p.p.' printed above the top tick of each panel
examples.why: 零线两侧发散＋单位置于顶刻度上方，现有样式维度无法生成。

examples.quote: Page begins with 'Note: ... Reading: In Norway, 7.6% ...' and 'https://stat.link/dmu0tr' for a figure not on this page
examples.why: 整页导出需处理跨页孤立注释块与两条StatLink的归属。
